Attached: stakeholder_map_finovate_v1.pdf (draft) and a short ROI one-pager we discussed.

Can you confirm: 1) list of stakeholders we should map (names/emails), and 2) earliest availability for the SE deep-dive next week?

Thanks — look forward to helping you enable internal champions.

Best,

Thanks Sophie — great, Thursday 11/19 10am PT works for us.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering Jan–Dec 2025. I’m attaching the SOC 2 cover letter and a redacted report link for your security team.
- DPA: We do have a standard DPA; legal is happy to review and we can route a customer-facing copy after NDA if needed.

I’ve also sketched a short champion enablement note for Michael and the exec team — see below (and attached as "Redwood_ROI_one-pager.xlsx"). Feel free to use/modify.

--- Champion enablement (editable) ---
Why Redwood for Finovate
- Predictable latency and throughput: real-world 95th latency under 350ms for typical scoring loads (see benchmark sheet).
- Cost efficiency: Intelligent batching + caching reduces per-transaction costs by ~40% vs naive serving.
- Security & controls: SOC 2 Type II, customer-managed keys, VPC private deployment options.

Key metrics we can commit to in a pilot
- Pilot target: 10k transactions/day, <500ms 95th, cost target <$0.02 per transaction (model dependent).

Suggested next steps
1) SE deep-dive (11/19) — validate latency/throughput on a 1–2 hour call with test payloads.
2) Security exchange — share SOC 2 and DPA draft; security Q&A follow-up.
3) Procurement intake — procurement to confirm commercial terms and any necessary procurement forms.

--- end note ---

Dev — can you prepare a simple perf-run template we can use in the SE deep-dive? Rachel — can you draft a one-paragraph email for Michael summarizing ROI to help Sophie push internally?

Best,
Marissa
